items.title: Unit 7 · Story
items.prompt: Listen to the story. Which word fills the gap?
items.spokenPrompt: Listen. Which word fills the gap?
items.spokenScene: A skunk jumps into the sea.
items.storyText: It's a pretty spring day. The squid kids are in school. A skunk jumps into the sea. Splash! He wants to catch the squids! The kids swim under their desks. They spray black ink. The skunk can't see! The squid teacher is strong. He picks up the skunk and puts him on the grass. The skunk is sorry!
items.why: In “A Bad Skunk”, you hear: A skunk jumps into the sea. The missing word is “skunk”.
items.hint: Listen to this part again, or play the whole story.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 4, Unit 7, p.71 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
